decision.title: Recommendations
decision.humanDecides: every proposal is justified; nothing is applied without your decision.

forecast.floodHelp: Opinion based on observed and forecast rain (6, 12, 24 h), low points and flow direction: this is not a hydraulic model.
forecast.simBand: Forecast computed on simulated weather data.

responders.title: Officials to involve

conference.title: Crisis conference
conference.intro: Audio room of the incident, joined from the dashboard phone.

phone.title: Phone

hotspots.intro: Hexagon grid: each cell counts reports, never a single point.

errors.title: Enter a title (Arabic or French).
errors.ended_at: The end is before the start.

fromIncident.hint: Creates a prefilled draft (timeline, figures, resources, delays) for the after-action review; nothing is published.

events.title: Events library
events.intro: A single search across the national memory, reports, incident timelines, citizen reports, transcripts and procedures.

rewards.title: Rewards

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Deployment settings, read-only (rescues excluded from the cap).
settings.noCash: No cash rewards in this version: annual financial prizes are a decision for the competent authority.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Changes are audited. Category rules override the default rule.
rules.readOnly: Editable by the central committee or an administrator (national scope).

badges.title: Badge confirmations
badges.intro: Silver, gold and ambassador are only shown after confirmation by a staff member (audited decision).

nominations.title: Nominations
nominations.humanDecides: A nomination is decided by another staff member; the decision is audited.
nominations.sameReviewer: The person who proposed cannot decide.

certificates.title: Distinction certificates
certificates.intro: PDF certificates (Arabic and French) with a public verification QR code (initials, distinction and date only).

done.release: Report released; the deadline does not restart.

done.refuse: Referral refused: the report goes back to the centre.

geo.label: Incident location

reasonCode.accuracy_crosses_border: The accuracy circle crosses into another gouvernorat

geo.queueIntro: Reports whose location is uncertain or contradictory: no room is assigned before verification. Critical reports are also shown to the candidate rooms so they are not delayed.

nearby.title: Open incidents nearby

command.title: Command and participants

levelHelp.regional: The lead room runs the incident; the centre follows it.
levelHelp.central: Central command: the centre coordinates and decides resource requests; regions carry out the intervention.

command.transferHelp: The current lead becomes a participant.

resourceRequests.title: Resource requests between gouvernorats
resourceRequests.intro: Each gouvernorat decides on its own resources: an incoming request is approved or refused by the owning region.
resourceRequests.centralNotice: The central room does not dispatch regional resources directly: request them from the owning region.

settings.title: National settings
settings.intro: Values applied to every room. Each change needs a reason and is audited.
settings.readOnly: Read-only: changes are made by the central committee.

delays.help: After this delay without a claim the report becomes late and the centre may answer it (defaults: 60 s critical, 90 s high, 120 s normal, 180 s low).

bands.title: Urgency band thresholds
bands.help: Minimum priority score (0–100) of each band; below “normal” the band is low.

quota.title: Anonymous report quota
quota.help: Accepted reports per installation before registration is required. SOS is never refused and 198 is always available.

accuracy.title: Trusted location accuracy
accuracy.help: A location less accurate than this goes to geographic verification.

release.help: Version offered to the phones. Below the latest build the app shows “What's new” with “Update” and “Later”; below the minimum build the update cannot be skipped (SOS and 198 stay reachable).

errors.notes: Each text has at most {{notes}} characters.

checkMax.label: Longest duration

appFeedback.title: Mobile app rating
appFeedback.help: The citizens’ ratings of the app, from one to five stars, and their remarks. A rating is not a request: for an answer there is “Contact us”. Every reading is logged.

breakGlass.pageIntroReviewer: Every break-glass grant. Review each one after it ends (nobody reviews their own).

reasons.not_a_point: The geometry is not a point

history.undoExplain: The layer goes back to how it was before this import.

visibility.title: Who sees the layer

statusHelp.draft: Draft: only the system administrator sees it.
statusHelp.published: Published: the audiences chosen below see it.
statusHelp.paused: Paused: off every map, its settings are kept.

visibility.sensitiveHelp: Only the minister and the administrator see it, never a governor, even during an open crisis axis. Every read of its places is in the audit log.

delete.title: Delete the layer
delete.explain: It leaves every map and package at once and stays 30 days in “Deleted”, where it can be restored as it was, then it is erased.

deleted.title: Deleted layers
deleted.purgeSure: I understand erasing is final: the layer, its places, imports and history.

review.title: Names review
review.help: A place with a suggested name is not shown to citizens until its name is accepted. Staff see it marked “Suggested name”.

groups.intro: Layers show on the map in these folders, in this order. A folder grants nothing: who sees a layer is set in its settings, and each user sees only the folders holding a layer they see.

item.title: Title

errors.title: The title is required ({{lang}}).
errors.tooLong: Line too long, 300 characters at most ({{lang}}).

contact.intro: Requests sent from the app: access to information (law 2016-22, with its legal deadline), non-urgent hazards, questions, suggestions, app problems and partnerships. This is not an emergency channel: the app tells citizens to call 198.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.truncated: Only the first 500 requests are listed: narrow the filters.
contact.anonymous: No contact details (answer in the app only)
contact.noteHint: Internal note: never shown to the requester.
contact.visibleHint: This text is shown to the requester in the app.

medical.intro: The reporter chose to attach their medical file to this report. It is shown only on request, and each opening is recorded in the audit log.

medical.referrals: Referred to specialists: {{referrals}}; locked medical opinions: {{opinions}}. Their content is not shown here.
medical.audited: This opening has been recorded in the audit log.

history.title: Missing person: location history
history.intro: Search the last 72 hours of positions of a person linked to this report, if they turned the history on. The person is told through the app.

history.noPoints: The history is on, but no position was kept in the last 72 hours.
history.notEnabled: This person has not turned the location history on.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.intro: Doctors who registered from the app, pending registrations first. Check the medical council registration number (and a Civil Protection doctor's staff number) before verifying: no medical file reaches an unverified doctor.

detail.audited: Opening this file is recorded in the audit log.

review.title: Verification
review.check: Check the number with the medical council, and call the doctor if needed, before verifying.

medicalCommittee.title: Medical committee
medicalCommittee.intro: The system administrator appoints Civil Protection doctors for a fixed term. From their Civil Protection doctor account, members consult the medical files and the specialists' opinions of every gouvernorat.

rules.who: Only a Civil Protection doctor verified by the medical coordinator can be appointed, never the administrator themselves. The term ends on its own on suspension, withdrawal or a change of status.
rules.keys: No shared password: the citizen's phone locks the file for each member with their personal key; the administrator reads no file.
rules.audit: Every appointment, renewal and revocation is logged and e-mailed to the doctor; every opening of a file by the committee needs a reason and is shown to the citizen.

medicalCommittee.confirmRevoke: Confirm the end of the term
medicalCommittee.candidatesHelp: Choose the term, then appoint the doctor. They are told by e-mail.
medicalCommittee.full: All seats are taken: end a term before appointing a new member.
medicalCommittee.noCandidate: No verified Civil Protection doctor outside the committee.

environment.development: Development environment: all data is test data
environment.training: Exercise: test data, not real reports

drafts.changedWhileTyping: This record changed while you were typing. Your text is kept; check the new state before sending.

hospitals.title: Nearest hospitals by road

plans.title: Intervention plans
plans.intro: The intervention plans drawn up and approved by the national committee, each hazard with its colour (the blue plan of the floods). A plan is uploaded once as a PDF and shown on the screen when needed; a new version repeals the previous one, which stays readable in the register.
plans.none: No plan recorded for this hazard yet.
plans.noFile: No PDF for this plan yet
plans.repealed: This version is repealed: the plan in force is a newer version.

hazards.title: Hazards and the colours of their plans
hazards.intro: The central room keeps the list of hazards and the colour of each one's plan, as approved by the national committee. A hazard is never deleted, only switched off.
hazards.keyHint: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and _ (e.g. cold_wave).

schedule.title: Daily, weekly and monthly programmes
schedule.intro: Each gouvernorat's programme for every activity: duty rosters, patrols, exercises, prevention visits, maintenance and more. Approved the way the gouvernorat chose, followed up activity by activity.
schedule.pickGouvernorat: Choose the gouvernorat to show its programme.

settings.title: How each gouvernorat approves its programmes
settings.intro: Each gouvernorat chooses how its programmes are approved; the head of its room decides. The choice is kept with a programme when it is sent.

template.title: Programme templates
template.noneYet: No template saved yet: save a programme as a template to reuse it.
template.keep: Save this programme as a template
template.name: Template name
template.intro: A programme repeats: it is saved once as a template and applied to the next periods, each activity on its day of the period. Saving under the same name replaces it.
